description.en:
Xiaqi X02 is Digit Robotics' humanoid service platform for reception, retail guidance, exhibition commentary and business inquiries. Its interaction system combines face tracking, sound localization, spoken dialogue, expressions and body movements to communicate with visitors.

The manufacturer describes support for multiple languages and Chinese dialects, along with autonomous movement across common indoor floor types. The robot's application behavior can be configured around a venue's information and service needs. Digit's RoboEase platform provides tools for building and managing robot applications, connecting customized interaction content with deployment and operational management.
